personality_one_liner: A joyful, touchable productivity space that turns dense calendar data into friendly, satisfying interactive cards.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around cards to make them feel like physical objects on a desk. Use controlled asymmetry and chunky vertical gaps.

do's: Floating action buttons (FAB) over tinted backgrounds.
Sticky headers covering the days of the week over the scrolling time axis.
dont's: Do not blur individual event cards or list items.
Do not blur form fields or body content regions.

screens.name: Today Agenda (Home)
screens.purpose: A scrollable, touch-friendly list of today's tasks and calendar events with a sticky day-header and a prominent FAB for quick creation.

states.loading: A centered spinner with pulsing skeleton cards simulating a day's agenda.
states.empty: A warm geometric abstract illustration (from images), a friendly 'All clear today!' message, and a 'Plan something' primary CTA.
states.error: Readable message 'Couldn't load today's schedule' with a bouncy 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Sticky top header with dates (Sun-Sat scrollable tape). Below, a vertical time grid mixed with chunky event cards. Cards should not stretch edge-to-edge; keep `lg` margin on both sides. Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored bottom-right above the bottom tabs. Uses a semantic color stripe on the left edge of each event card to denote category.

screens.name: Month View
screens.purpose: High-level overview of the month to spot busy days and patterns.

states.loading: Skeleton grid representing the 30-day calendar layout.
states.empty: Month grid populated but empty of badges, subtle 'No events this month' below.
states.error: Error reading 'Failed to sync calendar' + Retry.

screens.layout: Standard 7-column grid layout. Days with events/tasks show tactile dot indicators or micro-bars in semantic colors. Tapping a day opens a Bottom Sheet (agenda format) for that specific date rather than navigating away.

screens.name: Create Event / Task Modal
screens.purpose: A frictionless, tactile sheet to quickly log a new event or to-do item.

states.loading: Spinner overlaid on the save button.
states.empty: N/A - form is empty by default.
states.error: Inline validation text below fields if missing title or dates.

screens.layout: Full-bleed Bottom Sheet. Top uses a chunky segmented control (pill style) to toggle between 'Event' and 'Task'. Single column form, labels above inputs. Uses a sticky primary CTA ('Save') resting above the KeyboardAvoidingView at the bottom.

screens.name: Item Details
screens.purpose: Deep dive into a specific event or task to view notes, change status, or see assignees.

states.error: Failed to load details + Retry button.

screens.layout: Large hero typography for the title. 'Status' and 'Category' represented by brandTertiary chips. Assignees listed in a row of overlapping real avatars. Actionable buttons (Mark Complete, Delete) use full-width solid rounded containers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Tactile / Playful personality (Number 4) with friendly, touchable rounded elements and generous spacing to avoid a generic 'SaaS dashboard' look.
Never use Indigo, Violet, Purple, or Blue shades anywhere (as mandated). Rely on the warm coral/rose (#FF6B5C) 'brand' palette paired with warm off-whites.
For the Day/Agenda view, do not stretch cards edge-to-edge. Maintain horizontal 'lg' padding. Overlap overlapping events slightly with a small offset to simulate physical cards.
Event/Task cards must utilize multiple visual layers (shadows/borders) to look slightly elevated. Use the shadow_tier 2 setting.
When lists include assignees, prioritize using the real photo avatars defined in images over simple initials.
The FAB should have a blurred glass background using expo-blur placed behind it for an iOS native feel when scrolling.
Always place a gradient scrim behind text overlaid on onboarding images to guarantee WCAG contrast.
For empty states, ensure the provided 'empty_state_abstract' image fills a meaningful portion of the screen above a short, punchy copy snippet and a primary action.
Ensure 'Create Task' forms keep the Submit button anchored above the keyboard using KeyboardAvoidingView, never floating in the middle of scrolling content.
